CHATFIELD / MOSSSolo, duo, or trio. One route is enough.

Before the lockdown

This is an instruction hub. Students build in linked external tools or at the physical hardware station. Students choose one of three routes and complete its three stops. Allow roughly 35–45 minutes; use screenshots and written designs if generation or accounts slow a route down.

External tools open in a new tab. Check school access to Meshy, Inkarnate, Code.org, Firefly, Mureka, Blob Opera, Morse Code World, CyberChef, and picoCTF before class. Meshy and Inkarnate may require an account; never require a purchase. The creative route includes offline design alternatives.

Ghost Runner stop 1: choose an approved laptop/computer opening OR an RJ45 cable attempt. Prepare unplugged practice equipment, matching manuals, connectors, crimpers, and a tester.

All answers and checkmarks stay in this browser when storage is available. Nothing is automatically sent to Moss. Students download their mission record and show their work. The CTF runs on picoCTF; the signal tools run in their own tabs.

The trailer is included. Map, styles, and scripts are embedded in index.html; keep trailer.mp4, trailer-poster.jpg, and meme-starter.html beside it. This package does not change the existing Escape Moss's Lab app.
